verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs say Workers can "Schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows", and the Agents SDK lists built-in scheduling, so recurring jobs are a first-party capability. The evidence is only a one-line claim, though, and the Workflows material covers multi-step durable execution with retries, not recurring triggers. Missing for 10: documented cron trigger syntax and configuration, details on recurring schedule frequency and limits, and documented recurring triggering of Workflows rather than one-off runs, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
